source_says: Tỷ lệ chi trả theo FY (2). 2026: ≥85% → 120%; ≥75% → 110%; ≥65% hoặc chưa có FY → 100%; >0% và <65% → %FY; 0% → 0%. 2027: ≥90% → 120%; ≥80% → 110%; ≥70% hoặc chưa có FY → 100%; <70% → 0%. (A=B; Claude checked the p3 image, resolutions.json)
impact: Multiplies the CVTV quarterly sales bonus, the quarterly Premier bonus and the annual bonus (lines 398, 405, 410). 2026: FY 75-79 engine 1.00 vs 1.10 (-9%); FY 70-74 0.90 vs 1.00 (-10%); FY 65-69 0.80 vs 1.00 (-20%). 2027: FY 85-89 1.15 vs 1.10 (+4.5%); 80-84 1.05 vs 1.10 (-4.5%); 70-74 0.85 vs 1.00 (-15%). Benchmark agent at 15tr FYC/month: FY-scaled bonuses = 55.8tr/yr, so -5.6tr (FY75-79) to -11.2tr (FY65-69) per agent per year in 2026. Scenario runner x20 agents gives -112tr to -223tr. Also feeds art52_bonus_pct_fyp.

page: 069 p14 (+ p17 example); 034 p17-21 (Phụ lục 2); 035 p18 (Phụ lục 1-2)
source_says: 069 p14: 'Kết quả tính AIA FY (tháng, quý, năm) được làm tròn lên đến 0 số thập phân' (90.666% → 91%). But the same document's Minh họa 3 on p17 shows 100/120 = 83%, which is ordinary rounding. 034 Phụ lục 2 and 035 p18: monthly rate rounds half-up (74.50 → 75; 74.49 → 74). Quarter/year/period = average of the ROUNDED monthly values, rounded again ((74+74+75)/3 = 74.3 → 74).
engine_has: Toggle: HalfUp floor(x+0.5) (default) or RoundUp ceil(x-1e-12). Takes a single fy_pct and rounds it once. Does not average rounded monthly values.
impact: Affects only FY values sitting just under a tier edge. For CVTV, ceil vs half-up moves e.g. 74.3 → 75 (2026 factor 1.10 vs 1.00 under the correct table, so ±10% of FY-scaled bonuses for the affected agent). HalfUp for CQL/PAF+ matches 034/035. For CVTV, 069 itself conflicts (p14 text vs p17 example). The two-stage rounding (month, then average) is not modelled: low impact.

source_says: Monthly fee rate by % Đạt Chỉ Tiêu of the directly managed block: <50% 0%; ≥50%-<100% FYP 3% / 1mAA 1.5%; ≥100%-<115% FYP 4.5% / 1mAA 2.5%; ≥115% FYP 6% / 1mAA 3.5% (p4 image re-checked; A=B).
engine_has: r_fyp: ≥1.15 6%, ≥0.90 4.5%, ≥0.55 3%, else 0. r_aa: ≥1.15 3.5%, ≥0.90 2.5%, ≥0.55 1.5%, else 0. The lower thresholds are 0.55 and 0.90 instead of 0.50 and 1.00. The rates are correct.
impact: Monthly professional fee for PAF+. Achievement 50-54%: engine pays 0, source pays 3%×Q + 1.5% of monthly FYC (under-pays). Achievement 90-99%: engine pays 4.5%/2.5%, source pays 3%/1.5% (over-pays by 1.5pp×Q + 1pp of monthly FYC; on 300tr FYC/month at Q=1.2 that is about +8.4tr/month). No effect in the benchmark SAF scenario because achievement ≥115% every month.

Quarterly professional fee for PAF+ is under-paid when achievement is 110-114% (engine 2.0/1.5% vs 3.5/2.5%) or 120-129% (engine 3.5/2.5% vs 5.0/3.5%). Example: quarterly FYC 900tr, Q=1.2, achievement 125% → under-paid by 1.5pp×1.2 + 1pp of 900 = 25.2tr per quarter. The benchmark scenario (SAF Y1, achievement ≥167%) is not affected.

source_says: The professional fees (p4-5) are measured against the target of the 'khối quản lý trực tiếp' (directly managed block). p13: 'Đối với PAF/AF, chỉ tiêu khối trực tiếp là chỉ tiêu của chính PAF/AF đó. Chỉ tiêu tính trên khối trực tiếp của PSAF+ là chỉ tiêu PAF nếu không có thỏa thuận khác'. The base fee (p3) is measured against the whole-branch target 'theo chức danh tại vị'.
engine_has: One monthly_fyp / monthly_1maa vector, compared with the rank's own target, drives both the base fee and the professional fees. There is no direct-block vs whole-branch split, and PSAF+ is not switched to the PAF target.
impact: For PSAF..SPVP, the professional-fee achievement is wrong. Example: a SAF direct block measured against the SAF Y1 target (200-600) instead of the PAF target (72-216) gives much lower achievement, so lower rates, if inputs are direct-block figures. If inputs are whole-branch figures, the FYC base is overstated. Can move the prof fee by several tiers.

source_says: Annual title: CQL promoted/appointed before 2026 needs ≥3 quarters at 5 sao (10%) or ≥3 quarters at 4 sao+ (5%). CQL newly promoted/appointed in 2026 needs only ≥2 such quarters. A new CQL with no group FY is exempt from the FY ≥75% condition.
engine_has: Fixed ≥3 quarters and fy≥75 for everyone. No new-CQL flag.
impact: A new 2026 CQL with only 2 qualifying quarters gets 0 from the engine instead of 5-10% of annual direct-group FYC (e.g. 900tr → 45-90tr, deferred).

source_says: Paid in 3 instalments: 01/2028 15%, 01/2029 25%, 01/2030 60%. Each instalment requires that the person is still a CQL AND group AIA TOT năm ≥85% (or undetermined) at that payment date. Death/TTTBVV exempts condition 1. The document does not say whether a missed tranche rolls forward.
engine_has: The 15/25/60 split and the ≥85.0 operator are correct. But it uses one tot_pct for all three tranches and does not check 'still CQL'. The scenario runner passes tot_pct=max(85.0, k2_pct), so TOT always passes. total_earned (line 528) and the scenario's mg_deferred_all count 100% of the deferred amount no matter what.
impact: Benchmark manager (5 sao every quarter, 900tr FYC): 90tr per manager (360tr for 4 managers) is counted as earned with no forfeiture risk and no discounting over 2-4 years. Per-tranche TOT and retention risk are ignored. The 15/25/60 split and the 85% threshold themselves are OK.

source_says: Quarterly fees are closed in months 3/6/9/12 and paid in Kỳ 1 of the next month/quarter. The annual bonus is paid in 'Kỳ 1 năm tiếp theo hoặc định kỳ Công ty thông báo'.
engine_has: The annual bonus and the Q4 quarterly bonuses are counted in cash_paid_y1. deferred_post_y1 is hard-coded to 0.0.
impact: Timing only; the total is unchanged. Benchmark agent: annual bonus 10.8tr plus Q4 quarterly bonuses about 11.25tr (×FY factor) are paid in Y+1, not Y1. Overstates Y1 cash by about 22tr per agent.

source_says: 'Miễn xét điều kiện số tháng Chuyên viên có hoạt động trong quý đối với Chuyên viên có số tháng chuẩn nhỏ hơn hoặc bằng 2'. An active month requires ≥1 contract AND FYC ≥4tr (definition aa, p19).
engine_has: Always requires act≥3 (5S/4S) or ≥2 (3S). An active month is FYC≥4.0 only; contract count is not modelled.
impact: A new agent in their first quarter (≤2 standard months) loses Premier 5-15% of quarterly FYC plus the SYC bonus. E.g. 40tr FYC in a partial quarter → 4tr missed.

source_says: Phí dịch vụ Giới thiệu Chuyên viên mới (referral fee for SA referrers): FYC of the new agent in standard months 1-12 × Exchange Pro 20% / Exchange 10% / SA 5%, paid monthly, with 10% PIT withheld. Stops when the referrer becomes UM+.
engine_has: Not modelled for CVTV.
impact: An SA who refers recruits earns an extra 5-20% of each recruit's first-year FYC (e.g. 2 SA recruits at 60tr FYC → 6tr/yr). CVTV income is understated for recruiting agents.

source_says: Quarterly maintenance check from standard month 3: 1 net contract + 4tr net FYC per quarter, and FY at the review month ≥50% or none. If failed → SE (or termination). SE receives NO bonuses or service fees.
engine_has: No maintenance gate. With FY<50% the 2026 factor fy/100 still pays bonuses.
impact: For FY<50% or a quarter with no production, the engine still pays FY-scaled bonuses (at FY 45%, 45% of the bonus pool), while the source makes the agent SE or terminated with 0 bonus from then on.

source_says: 3-month onboarding: FYC 5 → 1.5tr, FYC 10 → 3tr per month, attendance ≥50%, ACK, 21-day free-look. Monthly FYC EXCLUDES the contract(s) that earned 1/72H. Only for SA licensed 01-06/2026.
engine_has: Thresholds ≥5/≥10 and amounts 1.5/3 are correct. But when 1/72H is paid, M1 FYC is reduced by a fixed 4.0 instead of excluding the whole 1/72H contract's FYC. The licence window and per-month checks are not modelled (one boolean per flag for M1-3).
impact: The 4.0 deduction is an engine proxy. If the 1/72H contract's FYC is >4tr, M1 eligibility is overstated by up to 1.5tr. Small.

source_says: A cancellation within 6 months recovers ALL related commission, bonuses and fees. Cancelled sales are removed from the ISSUE month and tiers are recalculated; the difference is recovered.
engine_has: clawback_amount = (fyc_total + gross_bonuses) × clawback_6m_fyc / fyc_total. This is a proportional proxy with no tier recalculation. The CQL and PAF calcs have no clawback at all.
impact: Could under-state recovery when cancellation drops a quarterly/Premier/annual tier (tier cliffs, e.g. 4S → 3S on 35tr). Size depends on the scenario; the default is 0.

source_says: 'Tỉ lệ hoàn thành chỉ tiêu, FY (%), số lượng, số lượt trung bình 1mAA được làm tròn 0 chữ số thập phân' (89.5% → 90%).
engine_has: Achievement ratios are not rounded (ach_fyp, ach_aa, ach_qf, ach_qa).
impact: At edges, e.g. 114.6% → source 115% (base 120%, prof 6%) vs engine below 115%. Affects the base fee (±20% of the fixed fee) and prof tiers. Low.

source_says: Monthly and quarterly quality factor: ≥75% 120%; ≥70% 110%; ≥65% 100%; ≥60% 80%; ≥50% 60%; <50% 0%. '(*) Khi chưa có FY nhận mức 100%'. Monthly uses Tỉ lệ FY tháng; quarterly uses FY quý.
engine_has: Tiers and ≥ operators are identical. One fy_pct is used for every month and quarter. There is no 'no FY → 100%' path.
impact: Tiers are correct. The single-FY simplification and the missing no-FY option are minor.

source_says: Fixed fee PAF 20, AF 35, PSAF 40, SAF 50, DRF 60, RF 70, DSRF 80, SRF 90, PVP 110, SPVP 130 (tr). Payout %: ≥115% 120%; ≥55%-<115% 100%; ≥35%-<55% 50%; <35% 0%. Hệ số chuyên cần: attendance ≥70% 100%, <70% 70%.
impact: None.

source_says: Seniority fee = (FYP actual − FYP target) × factor. Year 1: 5% for all FY (merged cell). Year 2+: FY<55% 0%, 55-<65% 4%, 65-<70% 5%, ≥70% 6%. Capped at the total basic monthly fee received in the last 12 months. Recovered if the person leaves or loses the PAF+ title within 12 months of receipt.
engine_has: Same rates and operators. Cap min(base_total, …). No 12-month clawback, and the fee is counted in cash_paid_y1.
impact: Rates are correct. The 12-month clawback/retention risk is not modelled (low).

source_says: Annual 5-year FYP/1mAA targets (p9-10) and monthly targets for Y1 (standard months) and Y2-Y5 (calendar months), PAF..SPVP.
engine_has: 1,300 rows. Compared by script against the verified reading: 0 mismatches for every rank/year/month/metric and the annual totals. Fixed fees in the CSV also match.
impact: None.

source_says: The quality factor multiplies only the FYP-achievement rate; the 1mAA rate is not multiplied. Indirect manager gets 50% of the direct report's 'Thực nhận' monthly/quarterly fee (cascading).
engine_has: FYC × (r_fyp×fy_fac + r_aa) for monthly and quarterly. indirect_50 = sub_paf_prof_fees_12m × 0.50.
impact: None.

source_says: 8 tiers on quarterly FYC: ≥150 40%, ≥120 35%, ≥90 30%, ≥70 25%, ≥50 20%, ≥35 15%, ≥20 10%, ≥16 4%. × FY payout ratio for the quarter. Partial quarter: tier from converted FYC, rate applied to ACTUAL FYC. Q1/2026 conversion by days; from Q2 by ×3/months since joining.
engine_has: Same tiers and ≥. Tier on converted FYC, applied to actual q_fyc. Conversion is by months (3/partial_q1_months) and only for quarter index 0.
impact: Tiers are correct. The Q1/2026 day-based conversion is approximated by months (low).

source_says: 5 Sao: FYC ≥70, 3 active months, FY ≥75% (2026) / ≥80% (2027) or no FY. 4 Sao: ≥35, 3, FY ≥65%/≥70% (merged cell with 3 Sao). 3 Sao: ≥20, ≥2, ≥65%/≥70%. Premier rate 15/10/5% × FY payout ratio. SYC bonus: 5 Sao 50%, 4 Sao 30% of quarterly SYC, NOT FY-scaled.
engine_has: Same thresholds, gates (65/75 for 2026, 70/80 for 2027) and rates. SYC rate 0.50/0.30/0, not multiplied by fy_fac.
impact: None, apart from the shared fy_fac error (MF-01) and the missing ≤2-month exemption (MF-09).

source_says: Annual FYC ≥1,600 20%; ≥800 14%; ≥300 10%; ≥150 6%; × FY payout ratio for the year.
engine_has: Same tiers and ≥; × fy_fac.
impact: None (apart from MF-01 and MF-08).

source_says: Thưởng 1/72H: FYC 04tr + 1 contract within the first 4 working days → 1.5tr. For agents joining from 01/01/2026. Not for directly recruited CQL/PAF+.
engine_has: 1.5 if is_new_sa and fast_72h_qualified.
impact: None.

source_says: Health package: ≥3 × 5 Sao and FY năm ≥75% or no FY → Cao Cấp. ≥3 × 4 Sao+ and FY ≥65% or no FY → Tiêu Chuẩn. Based on the previous year. Value not stated.
engine_has: Flag 2/1/0 with the same thresholds. Not priced.
impact: Non-cash; not priced, which is correct because the source gives no value.

source_says: Final warning ('Cảnh cáo lần cuối') → 70% of 'Thưởng' (bonuses, support, service fees). Termination → no bonus. Commission is not affected.
engine_has: disc_mult 0.70 applied to bonuses only, not to FYC/SYC.
impact: None. The termination case is not modelled (low).

source_says: Valid ACK received within 15 days of approval. Policies approved in 01/2026: on or before 28/02/2026.
engine_has: days ≤ 15, with the 2026-01 exception flag.
impact: None.

source_says: Monthly effective-recruitment fee on direct-group FYC: column FY nhóm trực tiếp <80% (or no FY): ≥50 20%, ≥20 15%, ≥7 12%, <7 8%. Column FY ≥80%: 24/18/15/10%. The JFW table in 069 Phụ lục 2 p21 has the same rates.
impact: None. Note: a group with no FY falls in the LOWER column in the source, which the engine cannot express. That is consistent as long as fy is numeric.

source_says: Quality-recruitment fee = direct FYC × (active CVTV count ≥6 12%, ≥4 8%, ≥2 5%) × FY factor (≥70% or no FY → 100%, <70% → actual FY). Personal attendance ≥50% required, waived in the appointment month.
engine_has: Same tiers. fy_act_fac 1.0 if fy≥70 else fy/100. Gated by attendance_ok.
impact: None.

source_says: Quarterly CQL title: 5 sao FYC ≥170, active count ≥14, new active CVTV ≥1 (Q1/2026) / ≥2 (from Q2); 4 sao ≥80, ≥9, ≥1/≥2; 3 sao ≥50, ≥6, ≥1/≥1. Direct-group FY ≥75% or no FY (merged cell). Fee 15/8/5% of quarterly direct FYC. Attendance 50%.
engine_has: Same thresholds. req_r = 1 for q==0 else 2. 3S uses qr≥1. Rates 0.15/0.08/0.05. Gated by attendance_ok and fy≥75.
impact: None. This assumes the simulation year starts in Q1/2026; for 2027 runs Q1 should need ≥2 (low).

source_says: Annual rate: 5 sao toàn năm 10%, 4 sao toàn năm 5%, with AIA FY năm nhóm ≥75%.
engine_has: 0.10 if fy≥75 and q_5s≥3; 0.05 if fy≥75 and q_4s_plus≥3.
impact: None for pre-2026 CQL (see MF-06 for new CQL).

source_says: New-CVTV companion fee when the new agent is directly recruited by the CQL: Exchange Pro 40%, Exchange 20%, SA 10% of the new agent's FYC, standard months 1-12. When the new agent is referred by another agent, the CQL they report to gets 20/10/5%.
engine_has: Direct case 10/20/40% correct. A single new_agent_type is used for all 12 months; the referred case (20/10/5) is not available.
impact: Direct case OK. The referred case is missing (low; it would over-state the fee if used for referred recruits).

source_says: Indirect training fee = Tổng phí A (direct effective-recruitment fee + JFW fee) of sub-CQL × 50% (level 2), 25% (level 3), 12.5% (level 4).
engine_has: gen2×0.50 + gen3×0.25 + gen4×0.125. The scenario (line 1671) uses direct_monthly only as A, which is consistent.
impact: None.

source_says: Promoted-CVTV recruitment fee = Tổng phí A of the newly promoted CQL × 150%, at most 30tr/month per new CQL. Requires parent CQL direct-group FY ≥75% (or no FY). Lasts 12 months from the first promotion to UM.
engine_has: min(30, base×1.5) × 12 if fy≥75.
impact: None. It assumes all 12 months fall in the year and only one new CQL (input limitation).

source_says: No service fee of section A is paid unless the CQL meets the maintenance targets and stays UM+. Maintenance (UM/SUM/DM/SDM): whole-branch 6-month FYC 30/45/75/105, active count 4/6/9/12, 1 recruit, 60% retention, 2 personal contracts. Failure → demoted one level.
engine_has: No maintenance gate.
impact: Low-production CQL scenarios over-state income: all CQL fees should be 0 or computed at the demoted level once maintenance fails. Not triggered by the benchmark (75tr/month).

source_says: CQL: the direct group or the whole branch of any direct UM+ that contributes more than 70% of the promotion target counts as 70% of the target. Not applied for SA→UM, nor for UM+ without direct UM+. PAF+: direct block counts 100%; each direct PAF+ branch is capped at 70%.
engine_has: CQL: no subs → uncapped; with subs → direct and each sub capped. PAF+: direct uncapped, subs capped.
impact: None in this function (but see MF-37 for the milestone script).

source_says: UM/SUM/DM/SDM: months in current role 3/6/6/6; recruits 2; direct UM+ 0/0/1/2; active 3 months 5/9/13/17; whole-branch FYC 6 months 50/100/200/400; direct FYC 50; retention 70%; personal contracts 2. PAF: 6 months, 3 UM+, 18 active, FYP 1,200, 70%.
engine_has: Same thresholds for recruits, UM+, active, FYC, direct FYC, 70%, contracts, and for PAF 3/18/1200/70. The months-in-role rows (3/6/6/6; PAF 6) are NOT checked.
impact: Thresholds are correct. The missing tenure check lets a milestone jump several titles at once (affects which fee schedule is applied; low-medium).

source_says: The 70% rule 'Không áp dụng cho trường hợp thăng tiến từ SA lên UM'.
engine_has: The 70% cap is applied at every ladder step including UM. For PAF the FYP 1,200 check also uses the cap (correct). The AF FYP 2,500 check (line 148) uses m.fyp_month×6 with no cap on sub-PAF+ branches.
impact: Title inference only. The SA→UM check could fail wrongly when a sub-unit exceeds 35 (70% of 50). In practice an SA has no sub-units, so the effect is small. The AF check may overstate.

source_says: AF promotion: 6 months in role, FYP 6 months 2,500, 5 UM+ (condition 1), 1mAA 3 months 35, retention 70% (or no FY), Vitality 'Vàng', courses, CAO approval.
engine_has: 5 UM+, 2,500, 35 checked. Tenure, retention, Vitality and approval are not checked.
impact: Thresholds are correct; the other conditions are omitted (low).

source_says: PAF+ title maintenance: (1A) 6-month FYP ≥70% of target and 1mAA 3 months ≥50%, or (1B) 12-month FYP ≥80%; whole-branch retention 60% (PAF-RF) / 55% (DSRF+) in 2026; attendance 50% each month. Failure → demotion (PAF → as low as UM).
engine_has: Not modelled.
impact: Low-achievement PAF+ scenarios keep the fixed fee at a title they would lose. The engine pays 50% of the base fee at 35-55% achievement, while 1A/1B maintenance fails below 70%/80% → demotion within a quarter.

source_says: Payment conditions: at least 1 in-force policy at the time of payment, agent contract in force with no resignation notice, the 3 agent-quality criteria (Ref AIAVAD 2501-017). Disciplinary termination → no bonus.
engine_has: Not modelled.
impact: Eligibility risk; not a rate difference. Low.

source_says: FY = first-year premium persistency (14 months; agent's own for CVTV, direct group for CQL). TOT = (F2+R2)/(F1×85%+R1×95%).
engine_has: The scenario uses the same k2_pct as FY for agent, manager and PAF, and sets TOT = max(85, k2). PAF+ uses 'SAF' Year 1 targets with 1,000tr FYP/month. These are modelling assumptions with no source.
impact: The scenario assumption forces CQL deferred vesting (see MF-07) and ties every tier to one persistency number. Flagged as an assumption.

source_says: Quarterly bonuses use 'Tỷ lệ chi trả theo FY Quý'; the annual bonus uses 'FY năm' (average of 12 monthly values).
engine_has: One fy_pct gives one fy_fac for all 4 quarters and the year.
impact: A simplification. Correct if FY is stable. If FY moves across a tier during the year, quarterly bonuses are mis-scaled by up to one tier step (10-20%).
